claim: If anyone builds superintelligent AI, everyone dies.
scope: Any superintelligent AI, built by anyone, by any method.
occurrence: Plain-English form of the title of Eliezer Yudkowsky and Nate Soares’s book “If Anyone Builds It, Everyone Dies” (September 16, 2025), whose “it” is artificial superintelligence.

P1.reason: A prediction; no distinct problem with how current evidence is described.

P2.reason: Drops the authors’ own condition: systems built with techniques and understanding like those available in 2025. The title applies to anyone building it in any way.

P3.reason: States extinction as certain. The international synthesis records disagreement about likelihood and timing, and current incidents do not establish the full chain to extinction.

W1.reason: Blunt, but it states the authors’ actual prediction; severity is not counted as rhetoric.

W2.reason: The proposed mechanism is resource-seeking, not hatred or human emotion.

review_status: AI research draft; not independently reviewed
note: Headline claim added October 6, 2026 at Leyla’s request for spicier headlines. Scored with the same claims-us-1.0 rubric; evidence comes from the topic research brief.
